problem: Visible safe shelter area differs from actual dry-area collision bounds during gusts.
expected: The marked safe area and rain exposure test use the same weather-dependent boundaries.
observed: RelayBoard marks left+12 through right-12 green in all weather.
RelayRun.shelterAt shifts left boundary to left+20 during positive wind.
An eight-pixel green strip can therefore indicate safety while wetness increases.
unknown: How often ordinary play uses the mismatched strip.
